chunk.content: Senangin is the fourfinger threadfin Eleutheronema tetradactylum (Shaw, 1804), family Polynemidae (Threadfins), distinguished by four free pectoral filaments; an Indo-Pacific marine, freshwater and brackish pelagic-neritic species.
chunk.source_quote: Teleostei (teleosts) > Carangaria/misc (Various families in series Carangaria) > Polynemidae (Threadfins) ... pectoral filaments 4 ... Marine; freshwater; brackish; pelagic-neritic; amphidromous
